def fit(K, yy, ids, others, pen=0.02, objective='ml'):
    from scipy.linalg import cho_factor
    from scipy.linalg import cho_solve
    from scipy.optimize import minimize
    m = yy[ids].mean()
    sd = yy[ids].std()
    q = (yy[ids] - m) / sd
    L = len(ids)
    I = np.eye(L)
    V = K[:, ids][:, :, ids].copy()
    J = np.r_[V, I[None, :, :]]
    diag = np.diag_indices(L)

    def fn(h):
        w = np.exp(h)
        A = np.einsum('i,ijk->jk', w, J)
        F = cho_factor(A, check_finite=False)
        a = cho_solve(F, q, check_finite=False)
        C = cho_solve(F, I, check_finite=False)
        if objective == 'ml':
            val = q @ a / 2 + np.log(F[0].diagonal()).sum()
            G = (C - np.outer(a, a)) / 2
        else:
            D = C[diag]
            e = a / D
            val = np.mean(e * e) * L / 2
            G = -np.outer(C @ (e / D), a) + C @ np.diag(e * e / D) @ C
        val += pen * sum(w[:-1])
        gr = w * np.einsum('ijk,jk->i', J, G)
        gr[:-1] += pen * w[:-1]
        return (val, gr)
    h0 = np.r_[np.full(len(K), -np.log(len(K))), -6.0]
    opt = minimize(fn, h0, jac=True, method='L-BFGS-B', bounds=[(-17, 6)] * len(K) + [(-14, 0)], options={'maxiter': 160, 'ftol': 1e-08})
    w = np.exp(opt.x)
    A = np.einsum('i,ijk->jk', w[:-1], V) + w[-1] * I
    F = cho_factor(A)
    a = cho_solve(F, q)
    C = cho_solve(F, I)
    out = np.einsum('i,ijk,k->j', w[:-1], K[:, others][:, :, ids], a) * sd + m
    return (out, abs(a / np.diag(C)).mean() * sd, w)
